63/S0.subgoal: Summarize the overall scope and structure of the course.

63/S1.subgoal: Describe the foundational concepts, historical evolution, and challenges of VR and AR systems.

63/S2.subgoal: Describe the hardware, software, and tracking methodologies used in extended reality systems.

63/S3.subgoal: Explain the importance of human factors, visual perception, and sensory immersion in XR experiences.

63/S4.subgoal: Outline the system development lifecycle, requirements gathering, and implementation aspects of XR.

63/S5.subgoal: Describe methods for optimizing both user experience and system resources in XR.

63/S6.subgoal: Explain how programming support and specific platforms link theoretical knowledge to practical XR development.

63/S7.subgoal: Identify advanced and interdisciplinary technologies not covered in the course.

63/S8.subgoal: Explain the core objective of the course: building a foundation for further knowledge extension.
